title: Nord Stream Gas Fueled This German Power Plant, Now It's Being Dismantled And Sent To Ukraine
content: The Greifswald industrial power plant was built at the landfall of Russia's Nord Stream pipelines in northeast Germany. After the sabotage of the gas pipeline the plant fell idle. Now it has become the latest major energy station in the EU to be broken up and transported to Ukraine.

title: Moscow Police Detain Hundreds Of Youths, Pressure Those Of Military Age Into Service
